description:
Provides Unix-style file commands for blob storage.
Commands:
  ls [-l] [--type TYPE] [--sort FIELD] [--count]
  file ID
  find PATTERN    Search files by name (case-insensitive substring match)
Options:
  -l, --details    Long listing format
  --type TYPE      Filter by type (image, audio, video, document)
  --sort FIELD     Sort by: time, size, name
  --count          Show count only
Examples:
  find speech      Find files with 'speech' in their name
  find i_am        Find the 'i_am.wav' file
embedding_description: Run Unix-style file commands against blob storage (ls, file, find). Supports type filters, sorting, and counts to list files, inspect metadata, or search by filename pattern across stored blobs and namespaces.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Structured file listing with filename, type, size, and date for each file
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Executing file command on blob storage
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ParseError: Invalid command syntax. NotFoundError: Specified file ID does not exist. StorageError: Failed to access blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For parse errors: check command syntax (ls, ls -l, file ID). For not found: verify the file ID exists. For storage errors: check storage accessibility.
